thread:
Maria G.: Quick sync — Saturday evening community circles + live demo flow. We have 3 x 30m demo slots from 6:15–7:45, two demo stations, and the small merch table. Need: staff schedule, final swag counts, lead-routing QR, and a fallback if queue spikes.
AJ: I can run staffing. Cover needed 5:45 load-in -> 8:30 teardown. Who can do 6:15–7:15 shift?
Lucas H.: I’ll own lead routing + form. Plan to use HubSpot form + short link. Will add UTM so analytics ties to event.
Kim S.: Swag inventory this morning: 120 stickers, 60 postcards, 35 tees (mixed sizes), 12 enamel pins, 25 portable power banks. I can push a reorder for stickers and tees if we need.
Devon P.: I can take the 6:15 slot. Also bringing an extra laptop + HDMI dongles. Need a tablet for quick form capture?
Riley: I can do 7:15–8:15 and help answer product questions at merch table.
Maria G.: Awesome. AJ — can you confirm load-in dock and table assignments? Kim — what's minimum reorder lead time?
AJ: Load-in dock 3, arrive by 5:30. Table assignments: table A = demos (2 stations), table B = merch/QR capture, table C = meet & greet. Power strip for each. Ops bot will ping load-in reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — load-in alert at 17:30 local, dock 3. :truck:
Kim S.: Reorder lead time 3 business days for tees, stickers next-day if we use our express vendor. If we need 50 more tees that’s a 72h lead.
Lucas H.: Drafted short HubSpot form and redirect. Final link: https://redwood.hsforms.com/xyz123. Will append UTM for channel attribution. Suggested UTM params:
```
utm_source=community-circles&utm_medium=qr&utm_campaign=evening-demo-2026&utm_content=stationA
```
I'll also generate a short URL for the QR.
Maria G.: Perfect. Can we also add a checkbox to opt into benchmark follow-up + webinar invite? We’ll route those leads to a special nurture sequence.
Lucas H.: Yes — added opt-in checkbox and a hidden field `source_event=evening-demo-2026`. Export mapping to CRM in CSV.
Devon P.: For the demo flow: propose 15m intro + 10m hands-on + 5m collect feedback/lead capture. That keeps throughput high. With two stations we can handle ~8 groups/hour.
AJ: Good. If queue > 10, switch to micro-demos (5–7m rapid walkthroughs) at station B to keep lines moving. Staff rotation: Maria + Devon on station A for first hour, Riley + volunteer on station B.
Kim S.: Swag allocation recommendation: keep 1 tee per 5 high-interest leads, 1 pin per 3, stickers freely handed. Power banks reserved for top-tier partners only (10). That saves tees.
Maria G.: Approved. Can someone create two QR codes: one for the HubSpot form (general leads) and one for the benchmark sign-up (deep-dive list)? I want distinct short links.
Lucas H.: On it. Short links: https://rwd.io/cc-leads and https://rwd.io/bench-sign. QR PNGs in #marketing-assets by Friday.
Riley: I’ll print 3 small signage cards with the QR + tagline: "See Redwood in action — 30m demos & benchmark opt-in".
Devon P.: FYI bring dongles: HDMI->USB-C, DisplayPort->USB-C, extra charger. Also tag us in the demo slide deck with the new CTA.
Maria G.: Final asks: Kim confirm final counts by Friday midday; Lucas push QR and form by Friday EOD; AJ update staffing roster and volunteer names by Friday EOD. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Kim S.: Confirmed — will reorder 50 stickers and 20 tees today. PO# PO-4523.
Lucas H.: Form live + QR ready, adding UTM per station. Will upload PNGs and CSV mapping.
AJ: Staffing roster updated — added a volunteer from partners (Sam). Will share shift table.
ops-bot: Post-event reminder scheduled — submit lead CSV by 21:00 same day.
Maria G.: Great work team. Quick reactions: if you can cover your asks, just drop a :thumbsup: below.
Riley: :thumbsup:
Devon P.: :thumbsup:
